BASIC.name: Basic Box
BASIC.subtitle: Daily Breaks & Quick Treats

2.label: Focused Hobby Session (45m)

PREMIUM.name: Premium Box

PREMIUM.concept: A reward for one or two days of goals completed with excellence.

0.label: Standard Leisure (45-60m)

1.label: Extended Leisure Voucher (75-90m)

EPIC.subtitle: Big Weekly Achievement
EPIC.concept: A substantial weekend reward to crown consistent days.

1.label: Full Free Evening (180m)
1.description: 3 free hours or a book/game on Steam sale.

2.label: Full Afternoon Unplugged (240m)
2.description: 4 hours of well-deserved rest and a full energy recharge.

LEGENDARY.name: Legendary Box

LEGENDARY.concept: The pinnacle of weeks of discipline and unbroken streaks. A memorable milestone.

0.description: 4 hours dedicated to your hobbies with duty fulfilled.

1.label: Full Day-Off (Entire Day)
1.description: A full day off from chores with complete streak protection.

2.label: Ultimate Celebration (Supreme Jackpot)
2.description: Free weekend + permission for a major real-life treat.
